k:HH.Scen.Editor.ModulesIntro: Modules this scenario switches on or off. A module you do not touch follows the player's template.
k:HH.Scen.Editor.Note: Only what you change here (marked amber) is set by the scenario. Unmarked rows show the default values; in a new game they come from the player's own template. Reset hands a row or module back to the template.
k:HH.Scen.Editor.Title: Hearth & Harbor rules of this scenario
k:HH.Scen.HarborTown.Intro:
The deed was signed in a hurry and the lawyer did not stay for tea. Now it is yours: a weathered inn above a quiet harbour, a road full of caravans and not a single guest.

Sweep the floors, mend the roof, make up a bed. Hang a sign. Somebody will knock before long - and if you treat them well, they will tell everyone on the road.

Tip: Hetty Hearthwell is the storyteller for builders. And the Hearth & Harbor guide at the top right explains one step at a time.
k:HH.Scen.Picker.Title: Choose a Hearth & Harbor setting
k:HH.Scen.Rules.Count: {0} setting(s) set; add single settings with the 'Hearth & Harbor setting' part.
k:HH.Scen.Rules.MoreTip: Opens the full Hearth & Harbor settings for this scenario. Only what you change there is set by the scenario.
k:HH.Scen.Rules.TierTip: Tick to let this scenario set the hosting difficulty (0–500 %). Unticked, the player's template decides.
k:HH.Serve.TipsTotal: Tips for the staff so far: {0} silver
k:HH.Setting.ai.func.claim.Desc: The answer letters of Clawback Mutual react to what you wrote in the claim form. The decision and the amount never change.
k:HH.Setting.ai.func.concierge.Desc: Ask the concierge a question about running your guests. It phrases the tips the game already knows.
k:HH.Setting.ai.func.headline: Market headlines
k:HH.Setting.ai.func.headline.Desc: The Rim Exchange news ticker gets headlines written by the AI. The numbers behind them do not change.
k:HH.Setting.ai.func.ottoline.Desc: Chat with Clerk Ottoline in the bank. She explains your accounts, loans, investments and policies. Without AI she answers a few quick questions from the books.
k:HH.Setting.ai.func.review.Desc: Some departing guests leave a review written in their own voice. Without AI the review is a short stock line.
k:HH.Setting.ai.maxPerDay.Desc: A courtesy limit of this game on its own requests, per in-game day. 0 = no local limit. The relay has its own shared daily budget.
k:HH.Setting.ai.reviewShare: Share of departing groups that leave a review
k:HH.Setting.ai.reviewShare.Desc: Keeps the number of AI requests small. 25 % means about one group in four.
k:HH.Setting.ai.showBadge.Desc: Adds a note to AI-written guest reviews and shows the AI badge in the chat and the concierge box. Market headlines get no mark.
k:HH.Setting.bank.accountBeta.Desc: Replaced by 'Account interest: share of the market return'. Kept so older save games load; changing it does nothing.
k:HH.Setting.bank.accountShare: Account interest: share of the market return
k:HH.Setting.bank.accountShare.Desc: A bank account only pays this fraction of the market's surplus (M - 1) a year, and never more than the savings product Mattress Plus (which follows the investment profitability). 0.2 means: at M 1.2 the account pays +4 % a year (the savings product Mattress Plus pays +8 %, the index about +20 %); at M 2 it pays +20 %. Below M 1 it loses a little, never more than 10 % a year. Both profitability sliders (this bank M and the investment M) are worth keeping close together. Each bank adds its own small bonus or malus. Investments are not affected.
k:HH.Setting.bank.atmDailyLimit.Desc: The most silver you can take out of ATMs per day.
k:HH.Setting.bank.bailout.Desc: The bank First Rim Bank of Too Big To Fail rescues a ruined former tycoon once per game year (an interest-free loan, not a gift).
k:HH.Setting.bank.collectionAnger.Desc: Multiplies the size of seizure teams and collection raids. 0 turns the violent stages off.
k:HH.Setting.bank.depositDelayHours.Desc: Silver put into the account without a bank counter or ATM nearby arrives after this many hours.
k:HH.Setting.bank.directDeposit: Route till money straight to the bank
k:HH.Setting.bank.directDeposit.Desc: Once an account exists, the tills of your businesses are emptied into the account at midnight instead of leaving silver on the floor.
k:HH.Setting.bank.directDepositFee.Desc: Fee on money that is routed straight into the account (till takings). 0 to 100 %.
k:HH.Setting.bank.feeFactor.Desc: Multiplies all fees of your bank. 0 % = no fees at all.
k:HH.Setting.bank.lateFee.Desc: Charged on the overdue instalment when a loan reaches collection stage 2.
k:HH.Setting.bank.loanFloor.Desc: Minimum credit limit for a colony with a fine score, so a young colony can borrow a little.
k:HH.Setting.bank.loanIntervalDays.Desc: Loan instalments are due every this many days.
k:HH.Setting.bank.loanPortfolioShare.Des: How much of your investments (at market value) counts as wealth when the bank decides how much you may borrow. 100 % = fully, 0 = not at all. The net worth shown in the lobby always counts them fully.
k:HH.Setting.bank.maxCollectionStage.Des: The collection ladder: 1 reminder, 2 late fee, 3 offset against deposits, 4 friendly visit, 5 seizure team, 6 collection raid, 7 bounty. Standard Room stops at 4: you pay your debt and lose nothing but a little mood.
k:HH.Setting.bank.moodOn.Desc: A small thought (from -4 to +3, doubled for greedy colonists, none for ascetics) depending on the net worth per colonist.
k:HH.Setting.bank.moodScale.Desc: Scales the net worth thresholds of the mood tiers (Broke … Too Big To Fail).
k:HH.Setting.bank.podMaxLoad.Desc: A big withdrawal comes in drop pods of about this many silver each, never more than 10 pods per withdrawal (huge sums make heavier pods instead of more of them). It does not limit how much you can deposit or withdraw.
k:HH.Setting.bank.podMinHours.Desc: Withdrawals without a counter or ATM come by drop pod after at least this long.
k:HH.Setting.bank.profit.Desc: How much invested money grows on average per game year (60 days). This is the bank's own M: it drives the account interest and loan rates. The investment M (Investments page) drives the markets; the account never pays more than Mattress Plus at that M. Keep both close together. 1.0 = plus/minus nothing, 1.2 = +20 % a year, 0 = the money disappears. Log scale 0.01 to 100; type a number for the exact value. Follows the difficulty slider until you set it yourself.
k:HH.Setting.bank.researchMode.Desc: Full: ATMs, night safes, branches and loans need their research. Off: everything is available from the start. (The global Research mode in the core settings does the same for every module.)
k:HH.Setting.bank.seizureShare.Desc: If the Black Ledger seizes your account (1 % risk per quadrum), this share of the balance is gone.
k:HH.Setting.bank.sounds.Desc: Clicks, coin counting, stamps in the bank window, and the lottery win or lose sound when a draw you bought tickets for is held.
k:HH.Setting.bank.switchFee.Desc: What it costs to move your account to another bank (KONZEPT 2.2: 50 silver).
k:HH.Setting.bank.tradeDeposit.Desc: Off by default, so selling to a trader still hands you coins you can spend at once. With this on (and direct deposit on), silver you receive from traders and trade ships is moved into the account right after the deal (at the direct deposit fee). Caravans are not affected.
k:HH.Setting.bank.wealthShare: Bank balance counts for the storyteller (%)
k:HH.Setting.bank.wealthShare.Desc: How much of the account counts towards the colony wealth that the storyteller uses for raid points. 100 % = fair: depositing money does not make raids smaller. 0 = the bank is a hiding place.
k:HH.Setting.casino.abstinenceDays.Desc: Days without any session needed to cure each stage of the addiction (stage 3 = 3 × this).
k:HH.Setting.casino.addictionFreeSession: Below this many sessions in three days nothing happens.
k:HH.Setting.casino.addictionP0.Desc: Chance of addiction after the third session within three days; it grows ×1.35 with each further session. 0 turns addiction off.
k:HH.Setting.casino.ambience.Desc: A soft murmur of voices, chips and distant slot bells in a busy casino room while the camera is near it.
k:HH.Setting.casino.animSpeed.Desc: 100 % is the designed pace. Higher numbers play the games faster; holding Shift plays them at 300 %.
k:HH.Setting.casino.animations.Desc: The Lucky Thrumbo and the practice games show the reels, the wheel and the cards in motion before the result. Off: the result appears at once. A click on the table, Space or Enter always skips the rest of an animation.
k:HH.Setting.casino.blackjackH17.Desc: 0 = dealer stands on soft 17, 1 = dealer hits (about +0.2 points of edge).
